news.title: Bitcoin rally shows signs of cooling even as a 'bull score' gauge nears its perfect score
news.summary: A trend guage tracked on onchain analysis firm CryptoQuant is near its ceiling. The buyers who drove BTC to an eight-month high are already pulling back.

news.title: Robinhood adds AI agents, perps and weekend trading in push to win active traders
news.summary: The brokerage is expanding its trading hours and adding leveraged crypto products and automated trading tools to attract more active investors.

news.title: Cboe, S&P Dow Jones may explore tokenized options contracts under extended licensing deal
news.summary: The agreement opens the door to tokenized derivatives as some of Wall Street's biggest institutions, including Nasdaq, NYSE and DTCC, move traditional markets onchain.
